aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.text1: Anbani is a custom furniture company delivering high-quality solutions that combine functionality, style, and durability. With more than 17 years of professional experience, we have built a strong reputation as a reliable partner for clients in over 15 countries. Since 2022, Anbani has been operating in Georgia.
aboutUs.text2: Our core values include attention to detail, the use of eco-friendly materials, and a continuous drive for innovation in furniture design and production. We offer a wide range of products, including kitchens, wardrobes and storage systems, children’s furniture, bathroom furniture, and office solutions.
aboutUs.text3: The Anbani team works closely with clients at every stage — from concept and design to manufacturing and installation — ensuring consistent quality and results that fully meet expectations. We create furniture that not only enhances interiors but also improves everyday living.

services.title: Our Services
services.description: We offer a full range of custom furniture services, including design, manufacturing, and installation. Our professional team is ready to help you create the perfect solution for your home or office. We take care of the entire process - from measurements to finished furniture in your space.

text1.subtitle: We visit the site and:
text1.line1: take precise measurements of the space
text1.line2: consider walls, corners, niches, and utilities
text1.line4: help you choose materials and fittings

text2.subtitle: We manufacture custom-built furniture to your measurements:
text2.line4: cabinets, chests of drawers, shelving units, and other furniture for home and office

text3.subtitle: We deliver the furniture and handle the installation:

services.subtitle4: With or without a design project

text4.subtitle: You get a result that perfectly fits your space. We work:
text4.line1: With a design project - we follow the drawings precisely
text4.line2: Without a project - we help plan the furniture from scratch

bi_residence.title: Bi Residence. Studio
bi_residence.description:
A bright and comfortable space fully furnished with our custom-made pieces.

Kitchen: MDF AGT, metal, accent lighting, and built-in Bosch appliances. Wall panels, the TV cabinet, the built-in wardrobe, and the bathroom vanity unit are all made of MDF AGT

bagrationi.title: Bagrationi Residence 1+1
bagrationi.description:
A compact yet highly functional 1+1 apartment with a walk-in closet and a bathroom, thoughtfully designed down to the smallest detail.
The layout includes a cozy kitchen–living area, a bedroom with a separate walk-in closet, and a modern bathroom.

A distinctive design feature is the kitchen divided into two functional blocks with fully integrated appliances, maximizing convenience and ergonomic use of space.

High-quality materials were used throughout: MDF AGT, quartzite, glass, and metal — a combination that creates a stylish and contemporary interior

porta_tower.title: Porta Tower — Apartment Ready for Living
porta_tower.description:
Stylish 2+1 apartment (85 m²) with MDT & AGT furniture — fully turnkey

✔ Premium kitchen with built-in furniture and appliances, accent lighting, and a quartz agglomerate island
✔ Two spacious bathrooms — fully equipped
✔ Functional storage solutions: illuminated cabinets, wardrobes, and hallway furniture
✔ Thoughtfully designed down to the smallest detail.

single_contour.title: Single Contour
single_contour.description:
A full apartment furniture project designed as one cohesive system. The kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closet, hallway furniture, and bedroom elements are unified by shared geometry, materials, and color logic.
Matte green-grey MDF facades are combined with wood-effect surfaces and black metal details. Integrated handles, concealed niches, and open sections are used throughout. All furniture volumes are aligned into a single visual contour, creating a consistent and structured interior.

country_house.title: Kitchen for a Country House in Poti
country_house.description: A kitchen designed for a private country house in Poti. The furniture features classic framed facades with a natural wood finish, creating a warm and solid appearance suited for everyday living outside the city. Upper cabinets with glass inserts add visual lightness, while tall units with integrated appliances form a clear and balanced architectural composition. The layout is based on symmetry and functionality, providing generous storage and comfortable daily use. Natural materials and a restrained color palette emphasize durability and a timeless character.

white_geometry.title: White Geometry
white_geometry.description: Matte white MDF kitchen with a linear layout and integrated appliances. A dark contrasting backsplash emphasizes the clean geometry. Large-format marble-effect porcelain flooring. Dining area with a round glass table and metal chairs.

kitchen_with_island.title: Corner Kitchen with Island — Pola Villas Cottage Community
kitchen_with_island.description: A corner kitchen with a functional island used as an additional workspace and everyday area. All appliances are fully built-in and integrated into floor-to-ceiling cabinetry, maintaining clean lines and a cohesive appearance. Quartz composite countertops provide durability and practicality. Light finishes combined with warm wood textures create a calm, modern interior.

integrated_kitchen.title: Integrated Kitchen with MDF Profile Facades
integrated_kitchen.description: A kitchen built with MDF profile facades and integrated handle solutions. The opening system is based on a gola profile, allowing the fronts to remain visually clean and continuous. Precise geometry and smooth surfaces form a unified volume where storage and appliances are fully integrated. The kitchen is designed for everyday functionality while maintaining a restrained, architectural appearance.

green_wood.title: Green Wood
green_wood.description:
A modern functional kitchen made of MDF and MDF AGT.
Soft green facades combined with natural wood texture create a balanced, timeless look.
The key feature is a two-level countertop: a 100 cm sink area and a 90 cm working area designed for everyday comfort.
Ceiling-height cabinets, open decorative shelves and integrated task lighting complete the space.
A kitchen focused on ergonomics, functionality and active cooking.

functional_minimalism.title: Functional Minimalism
functional_minimalism.description: A straight-line kitchen with clean, precise geometry. Matte MDF facades in a neutral tone. Black surface-mounted handles act as the only graphic accent. Upper and lower cabinets are aligned into a flat composition, with built-in appliances seamlessly integrated. The furniture focuses on functionality and visual clarity.

captains_family.title: Kitchen for a Captain's Family
captains_family.description: A kitchen designed as a spacious, separate room functioning as an independent space. A linear layout with MDF AGT Supramat fronts, integrated Bosch appliances, and a quartz worktop. Restrained geometry, integrated lighting, and a well-organized storage system support everyday family life.

snow_white.title: Snow-White Kitchen with Island
snow_white.description: The kitchen is designed in a snow-white color palette with an emphasis on clean lines and a balanced composition. The project features a built-in glass cabinet and fully integrated appliances, creating a cohesive and refined visual appearance. A kitchen island provides additional workspace and functional use. Quartz composite countertops enhance the restrained aesthetic while ensuring durability and everyday practicality.

linea.title: Built-In Entryway Wardrobe Linea
linea.description: A floor-to-ceiling built-in entryway wardrobe seamlessly integrated into the hallway. Matte fronts in a light neutral tone create a calm visual base and enhance the sense of space. Vertical surface-mounted bar handles emphasize height and clean geometry. An illuminated shoe niche adds depth and everyday functionality.

integrated_storage.title: Functional Hallway with Integrated Storage
integrated_storage.description: A hallway featuring built-in storage systems with dark wood finishes and sliding fronts. The composition combines closed storage, an open section with hooks and seating, a full-height mirror, and concealed functional modules. The layout is designed for everyday convenience and a clean, well-organized appearance.

contrasting_entryway.title: Contrasting Entryway
contrasting_entryway.description: Two built-in wardrobes positioned opposite each other. Matte dark finishes are combined with warm wood textures. A backlit mirror enhances spatial depth and creates a focused lighting accent. Clean geometry and functional storage.

warm_minimalism.title: Bathroom in Warm Minimalist Style
warm_minimalism.description:
Bathroom in a warm minimalism style.
Custom-made furniture made of MDF with a matte finish, combined with glass and metal elements.
Integrated lighting highlights the furniture’s geometry and provides soft, comfortable illumination.

gray_geometry.title: Gray Geometry Bathroom
gray_geometry.description: A modern bathroom designed in a gray palette with a distinctive geometric accent. Minimalist design, suspended furniture with matte finishes, and built-in niches create a sense of order and visual lightness. A round LED mirror and concealed installation systems emphasize clean lines, functionality, and the contemporary character of the interior.

concrete_and_wood.title: Modern Concrete & Wood Bathroom
concrete_and_wood.description: A modern bathroom combining concrete-gray finishes with warm wood textures. Furniture, built-in cabinets, and open niches are designed in a consistent style, creating a clean and visually balanced composition. Clear geometry and a thoughtful layout result in a functional and calm space.

LA_QUINTA.title: Bedroom set crafted from MDF — clean lines and flawless geometry.
LA_QUINTA.description:
Backlit mirror with soft LED lighting
Decorative MDF panels adding depth, rhythm, and architectural character
A modern design with a warm palette and thoughtfully integrated lighting creates a refined, elegant atmosphere in every detail.

storage_systems_1.title: Bedroom with Built-In Storage Systems
storage_systems_1.description: The bedroom interior is designed in a calm, neutral palette with an emphasis on built-in furniture. Floor-to-ceiling wardrobes feature clean geometry and vertical surface-mounted handles. The interior layout includes shelving and storage sections with integrated lighting. Additional niches and open elements add depth and visual balance. The furniture is seamlessly integrated into the room’s architecture, enhancing clarity and spatial harmony.

storage_systems_2.title: Bedroom with Built-In Storage System
storage_systems_2.description:
The bedroom is designed in a calm, neutral palette with a focus on built-in furniture. A sliding wardrobe with glossy warm beige fronts and a black aluminum profile runs along the wall. The interior layout includes open shelves, drawers, and hanging rails for practical everyday storage.
Soft perimeter ceiling lighting and integrated wardrobe illumination create a cozy evening atmosphere and emphasize the clean geometry of the space. Case furniture and the bedside unit are designed in a single style, forming a cohesive and balanced bedroom interior.
The bed is not part of the completed work and is shown as a furnishing element only.

helper_tower.title: Anbani Little Helper Tower
helper_tower.description:
A multifunctional children’s tower designed to safely involve a child in everyday activities such as cooking, washing hands, or working at counter height. It provides stable support and encourages independence through daily interaction.

The adjustable step allows the tower to be used as the child grows. The well-balanced structure ensures safety and stability for regular home or educational use.

Specifications:
✔ material: furniture-grade sanded birch plywood
✔ water-repellent protective finish
✔ 4 adjustable step positions
✔ stable and ergonomic construction
✔ overall dimensions: 90 × 50 × 48 cm

growing_chair.title: Adjustable Growing Chair “ანბანი” (Anbani)
growing_chair.description:
The “ანბანი” growing chair is a multifunctional piece of furniture designed for long-term use and adaptation to a child’s growth. Suitable for children from 1.5 years old, the chair grows together with the child, adjusting in height and configuration over time.

With adjustable seat and footrest in both height and depth, the chair provides comfortable seating for various activities including meals, learning, creative work, and everyday use. The stable structure with a wide base ensures safety and reliability.

The chair is made of eco-friendly 15 mm furniture-grade plywood with a water-repellent finish. It is suitable for home use as well as kindergartens and educational centers.

Technical Specifications
✔ Age: from 1.5 years
✔ Adjustable seat and footrest: height and depth
✔ Height adjustment step: 3 cm
✔ Maximum load: up to 100 kg
✔ Material: 15 mm furniture-grade plywood
✔ Finish: water-repellent coating
✔ Designed for long-term, multifunctional use

Dimensions
✔ Overall size: 85 × 50 × 46 cm (H × L × W)
✔ Seat: 40 × 22.5 cm (W × D)
✔ Footrest: 40 × 30 cm (W ×

with_ouvered_fronts.title: Built-in Wardrobe with Louvered Fronts
with_ouvered_fronts.description:
This built-in wardrobe embodies refined elegance and well-considered functionality.
The louvered fronts introduce rhythm and depth, giving the structure a light, architectural presence. The calm, sophisticated color enhances the premium feel and blends seamlessly with the surrounding interior finishes.

Designed from floor to ceiling, the wardrobe is fully integrated into the space, maximizing storage while maintaining a clean, uncluttered appearance. The interior layout is thoughtfully arranged with practical shelving, providing convenient storage for clothing, textiles, and everyday items.

A custom-made solution that combines modern design with timeless aesthetics and intelligent space planning.

graphite_line.title: Graphite Line
graphite_line.description: A unified furniture solution combining a freestanding wardrobe and a wardrobe with an integrated workspace. Matte dark-toned facades, clean geometry, and minimalist vertical handles create a refined contemporary look. Thoughtful storage and a compact workspace ensure functionality without visual clutter.

with_lighting.title: Built-in bedroom wardrobe with lighting
with_lighting.description: A built-in wardrobe designed for a bedroom, featuring smooth fronts and vertical surface-mounted handles. The interior includes a hanging section, storage shelves, and a lower zone for shoes or boxes. Integrated lighting highlights the internal structure and improves everyday usability. A balanced combination of light façades and warm wood-tone interiors.

wooden_wardrobe.title: Built-in Wooden Wardrobe with Louvered Facades
wooden_wardrobe.description: A full-height built-in wardrobe made of natural wood, designed as an architectural part of the space. Vertical louvered facades create a clear rhythm, provide natural ventilation, and emphasize the natural texture of the material. The wardrobe is fully integrated into the room geometry, maintaining visual balance and a sense of openness. Warm wood tones work with textured walls and soft lighting to form a calm, refined interior solution.

kindergarten_space.title: Kindergarten Activity Space
kindergarten_space.description: This kindergarten project is designed to encourage active engagement, development, and visual stimulation. The interior features a combination of bright and contrasting colors — green, yellow, blue, and orange — creating a lively and energetic atmosphere. Nature-inspired decorative elements such as a tree, clouds, and birds add a friendly and recognizable character to the space. Child-scale furniture with rounded shapes, stable tables, and open storage supports play-based learning and group activities. The layout is organized to accommodate classes, creativity, and interaction.

organic_shop.title: Custom Wooden Furniture for Organic Shop, Batumi
organic_shop.description:
A complete set of custom wooden retail furniture was created for an organic shop. The scope includes a central display shelving unit, modular storage systems, open shelving, and a separate floor-standing unit for customer bags and baskets.
Made from natural wood combined with a metal frame, all elements form a cohesive and practical retail system designed for clear product display and everyday use.
